g.text: Diagram Hubungan Entitas (Entity Relationship Diagram - ERD) Database Production Supabase

svg.g:
users (Akun Pengguna)
PK id BIGINT (PK) name VARCHAR(255)
UQ email VARCHAR(255) password VARCHAR(255) role VARCHAR(50) email_verified_at TIMESTAMP created_at TIMESTAMP g>
profiles (Profil Penyewa Lengkap)
PK id BIGINT (PK)
FK user_id BIGINT (FK) full_name VARCHAR(255)
UQ nik VARCHAR(16) phone VARCHAR(25) address_line TEXT kelurahan VARCHAR(120) kecamatan VARCHAR(120) city VARCHAR(120) province VARCHAR(120) postal_code VARCHAR(20) emergency_name VARCHAR(120) emergency_phone VARCHAR(25) is_completed BOOLEAN g>
categories (Kategori Alat)
PK id BIGINT (PK) name VARCHAR(100)
UQ slug VARCHAR(100) description TEXT icon VARCHAR(255) created_at TIMESTAMP g>
equipments (Katalog Peralatan)
PK id BIGINT (PK)
FK category_id BIGINT (FK) name VARCHAR(255)
UQ slug VARCHAR(255) price_per_day DECIMAL(12,2) status VARCHAR(50) description TEXT image_url VARCHAR(500) created_at TIMESTAMP g>
orders (Transaksi Menyewa)
PK id BIGINT (PK)
FK user_id BIGINT (FK)
UQ order_number VARCHAR(50) status_pembayaran VARCHAR(50) status_pesanan VARCHAR(50) total_amount DECIMAL(12,2) additional_fee DECIMAL(12,2) additional_fee_note TEXT rental_start_date DATE rental_end_date DATE created_at TIMESTAMP g>
order_items (Detail Item Rincian)
PK id BIGINT (PK)
FK order_id BIGINT (FK)
FK equipment_id BIGINT (FK) qty INT price DECIMAL(12,2) subtotal DECIMAL(12,2) rental_start_date DATE rental_end_date DATE g>
payments (Pembayaran Midtrans)
PK id BIGINT (PK)
FK order_id BIGINT (FK) transaction_id VARCHAR(255) payment_type VARCHAR(50) gross_amount DECIMAL(12,2) transaction_status VARCHAR(50) paid_at TIMESTAMP g>
admins (Pengelola Sistem)
PK id BIGINT (PK) name VARCHAR(255)
UQ email VARCHAR(255) role VARCHAR(50) password VARCHAR(255) created_at TIMESTAMP g>
audit_logs (Log Jejak Admin)
PK id BIGINT (PK)
FK admin_id BIGINT (FK) action VARCHAR(100) target_table VARCHAR(100) target_id BIGINT payload JSONB created_at TIMESTAMP g>
KETERANGAN SKEMA:
PK Primary Key
FK Foreign Key
UQ Unique Constraint
Relasi Kardinalitas (1:1 / 1:N)
Manake Media Equipment Rental Database v2.0
